name: cheatah Javadoc tags
comment: Highlights Doxygen/Javadoc tags inside doc comments — the STANDARD ones (@param, @return, @brief, …) AND cheatah's custom ones (@complexity, @alloc, @test, @crtest, @systest) — so they take the same theme color. Injected into C/C++ doc comments AND cheatah `#` comments (.purr) via package.json grammars[].injectTo (source.cpp, source.c, source.cheatah). The leading `#`/`*`/`/` lookbehind lets it fire in both `* @param` (C++) and `# @param` (cheatah) comment styles.
